description:
List all banned users in a server.

Args:
  - guild_id (string): Discord server/guild ID
  - limit (number): Number of bans to return (1-1000, default 100)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format

Returns:
  List of banned users with reasons

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

name: discord_list_bans
title: List Bans
